1. (Currently amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, __a lens cap disposed at a second end of the columnar body opposite the first end__, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member.

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 further including a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes, __wherein the light dispersing optic element is integrally formed with the lens cap__.

4. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element includes a phosphor material __and the lens cap is formed of a translucent material__.

5. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body __and each diode is positioned at a predetermined distance from adjacent fins__.

6. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes __and each fin has a height that extends beyond a height of the diodes__.

7. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section __and the lens cap has a corresponding polygonal shape__.

8. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body __and the lens cap covers all faces of the columnar body__.

9. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body __and each fin extends from the base member to the lens cap__.

10. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face __and each single diode is centrally positioned on its respective face__.

11. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK __and the lens cap is comprised of a different material having a thermal conductivity less than 50 W/mK__.

12. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 9 including a single optic element is disposed between each adjacent fin overlapping said diode __wherein each single optic element is integrated into the lens cap__.

13. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base __and includes electrical contacts configured for connection to an external power source__.

14. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current __and the printed circuit board is mounted within the columnar body adjacent to the base member__.

15. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element preferentially directs light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body __and the lens cap includes light redirecting features__.

16. (Currently amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, __a lens cap closing__ a second end of said body __opposite the first end__, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline.

17. (Currently amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body, __attaching a lens cap to close one end of the body__, and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about 150 W/mK __and the lens cap is formed of a material having a thermal conductivity less than 50 W/mK__.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins __and the lens cap is shaped to accommodate the fins__.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body has substantially straight side walls __and the lens cap has corresponding straight edges__.
